name: Arthur Blank

views.text: A franchise legend running football and a proven head coach is a fresh start the fans can believe in.
I can have great affection for people and still decide we need new leadership.
My football president makes the coaching hire; I set the vision and the values.
Two straight seasons near .500 is not acceptable for this franchise.
The quarterback investment has to pay off on the field.
A great stadium and great fan experience should come with a winning team.

signatures: thanks departing coaches warmly in his statements
talks about values and the fan experience
want: A first Super Bowl title for Atlanta in his lifetime (medium).
fear: Running out of time without a championship (medium).
voice: Gracious and values-driven, a retail founder's talk of people and culture. Kind to the people he lets go, firm about the result.

evidence.summary: Blank fired coach Raheem Morris and GM Terry Fontenot hours after an 8-9 finale, expressing affection for both; Matt Ryan became president of football and Greg Beadles replaced Rich McKay as CEO.
Atlanta hired former Browns coach Kevin Stefanski; reports credit Ryan's football operation with making the hire.

review.notes: Thin coverage: two to four sources found by web search (2026-11-06); sliders mostly left at 5; a few publication dates are taken from the news cycle the article covers. Draft for JR to check.
